MOVE: A/D or ←/→ · JUMP: W / ↑ / Space · double-jump enabled
P: pause/resume · R: restart · H: end game early
LIVES: falls, mines, or time can cost a life · medical kits can add lives · Shield blocks one mine hit
GOAL: keep moving right through as many levels as possible; unlocked outfits/backgrounds progress again each run
On iPhone: tap P = pause/resume · hold R = restart · hold E = end early · use the touch controls. Some elevated bonuses unlock special routes. There may also be a secret code...
